name: Tenants Evicted
overview: The parable of the tenants evicted reveals God's righteous judgment against those who reject His authority and fail to bear fruit in His vineyard. The wicked tenants are condemned and destroyed, and the vineyard is given to others who will faithfully produce the fruits in their seasons. This teaches that God will hold accountable those entrusted with His kingdom and will entrust it to faithful stewards who honor Him.
